kultivator.sekte.paviliun.ui.altar.rules: Blessing = 1%% per spirit tablet (max 10%%) + 5%% × freshness. Freshness is full after any rite and falls by 1/7 a day. The blessing lifts the disciples' contentment and speeds the heir ritual.

No Ancestral Altar yet (needs template 2+, raise the template on the Build page): the tablets stand before the cemetery stele and incense is offered there. Blessing = 1%% per tablet (max 10%%) + 5%% × freshness.
